rows.jyutping: mou5 jan4 waai4 ji4 ge3 N
rows.note: This is the all-purpose casual construction for something that has not aroused anyone's suspicion.

example.english: The unsuspected employee turned out to have stolen the company's money.
example.traditional: 嗰個冇人懷疑嘅員工原來偷咗公司啲錢。
